title: readstruct
summary: Read XML data into a scalar structure.

gpu_support.notes: Host file I/O; GPU-resident inputs are gathered before execution.

description: `readstruct(filename)` reads XML from the active RunMat filesystem provider and returns a scalar struct projection of the root element.
behaviors: Supports XML input with elements, text nodes, attributes, repeated sibling elements, comments/prolog skipping, entity unescaping, and malformed-tag validation through the shared XML parser.
Supports common name-value options `FileType` with value `xml`, `AttributeSuffix`, and `TextNodeName`.

Attributes are imported as fields named `<attribute><AttributeSuffix>`, text on non-leaf elements is stored under `TextNodeName`, and repeated element names are represented as cell columns because RunMat does not yet expose MATLAB struct arrays in this layer.
HDF5, Parquet, JSON, and full schema-aware import behavior are outside this XML compatibility slice.
